item.title: Russian raids cut power for hundreds of thousands
item.description: Recent strikes targeting Ukrainian utility grids in the Dnipropetrovsk and Kharkiv regions left approximately 850,000 residents without electricity.

item.title: Ram Pothineni joins upcoming Rajinikanth project
item.description: Actor Ram Pothineni has joined the upcoming movie 'Dharman', which stars Rajinikanth as a physician alongside cast members Nayanthara and Raashii Khanna.

item.title: ANC struggles in South African municipal polls
item.description: Following the tabulation of 99 percent of ballots, President Cyril Ramaphosa's political party secured 31 percent of the total nationwide vote.

item.title: US military strikes ship amid Hormuz blockade
item.description: The US military targeted a vessel attempting to depart an Iranian port amid a blockade, while Iran reported that three non-compliant oil tankers caught fire in the strait.

item.title: Delhi: Major blaze erupts at Najafgarh clothing factory
item.description: On Sunday afternoon, a major fire started at a clothing manufacturing unit in the Nangli Sakrawati area of Najafgarh, Delhi. Local authorities received the alert at approximately 4:22 pm and rushed 25 firefighting vehicles to control the flames.

item.title: Tamil Nadu Deepavali celebrations leave one child dead
item.description: During the Deepavali festival in Tamil Nadu, one minor died and 269 individuals sought medical care for burn injuries. Authorities stationed 1,283 emergency ambulances throughout the region to handle the festive caseload.

item.title: US Midterm losses prompt MAGA movement to question Trump
item.description: Following a defeat in the US midterms, certain members within the MAGA coalition are reconsidering Donald Trump's political impact. Supporters who previously considered him a major asset are now debating whether he is a liability.

item.title: Ancient Germanic elite graves uncovered in France
item.description: In France, researchers unearthed a fifth-century cemetery containing elite burial sites. The graves feature elaborate weaponry and warhorses, with two likely belonging to Germanic chieftains.

item.title: Sonia and Priyanka Gandhi share memories of Rajiv Gandhi
item.description: Sonia Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi reflected on past Diwali celebrations involving Rajiv Gandhi. A video capturing their personal recollections was released.

item.title: Devotees gather at Loknath Ashram for Kartik Brata
item.description: Worshippers of Loknath Brahmachari have assembled at the Shri Shri Loknath Brahmachari Ashram to observe Kartik Brata. Followers engage in a month-long fast during the Bengali month of Kartik to pray for family welfare.

item.title: New Jersey store gives $30,000 Powerball bonus to food bank
item.description: A Wegmans supermarket in New Jersey sold an $847 million winning Powerball ticket on November 4, ending a lengthy jackpot drought. The retail store is donating its entire $30,000 sales bonus to a local food bank.

item.title: Karnataka CM criticizes BJP and JD(S) over welfare schemes
item.description: Karnataka Chief Minister Shivakumar stated that BJP and JD(S) politicians oppose welfare guarantees reaching the public. Concurrently, local Congress members protested against district minister K.M. Shivalinge Gowda for allegedly sidelining party colleagues.

item.title: Jaipur Cafe Proprietor Attacked and Injured with Metal Rods
item.description: A Jaipur cafe owner sustained severe injuries after being ambushed and struck with iron rods by assailants. Following the assault, the victim, identified as Gopalia, was hospitalized at Fortis Hospital.

item.title: Pilgrim Passes Away During Ascent of Chikkamagaluru Hill
item.description: A Bengaluru-based private sector employee named Lakshman died while trekking up Deviramma Betta in Chikkamagaluru. He had traveled overnight to visit relatives in Huvinahalli before undertaking the early morning climb.

item.title: LPG Buyers in Dhaka Forced to Pay Excess Charges
item.description: Despite recent adjustments to commissions for importers and sellers, liquefied petroleum gas remains unavailable at official rates. Buyers in Dhaka continue to face additional costs ranging from 300 to 440 taka.
